name: Moving Costs Grant
description: The Moving Costs Grant is a financial assistance product that helps eligible clients cover the costs of moving to new accommodation.

attributes.summary: A grant providing financial assistance for moving costs, subject to income, asset, and accommodation eligibility criteria under the Housing Support Products umbrella.
attributes.eligibility: Residence, income limit, cash asset limit, able to obtain and retain accommodation, accommodation subject to or exempt from Residential Tenancies Act 1986
attributes.payment_details: Exceptional circumstances, shared moving costs, types of moving costs, recovery of payment
attributes.obligations: Client caused or contributed to the need, impact on the client and their family, accommodation is suitable to live in, staying in accommodation for more than 28 days, other financial assistance available to the client, resources available to the client, clients with existing debt, unable to meet essential living expenses
